scope: July 2026 U.S. freight and food price observations relevant to Randolph diesel/shipping-fuel transmission claims
calibration_rules: Monthly and year-over-year changes are non-equivalent and must be scored separately.
A diesel or shipping-fuel forecast is not confirmed merely because one food category rises while another falls.
Food transmission should be tested at multiple lags because fuel cost changes may enter transportation, processing, storage, and retail pricing at different times.
Truck-freight PPI is a price measure, not a physical freight-volume measure; later volume/index evidence should remain a separate lane.
The July data are compatible with persistent annual energy stress and simultaneous short-run monthly easing; neither posture may be erased to simplify scoring.
